extracted.name: Mulled quince cider
extracted.description: Enjoy this take on mulled cider, made with quince in place of apples. The leftover cooked quince can be served with hot custard as a quick sweet treat
ingredient_lines: 1 quince peeled, cored and cut into eighths
instruction_lines: Pour the cider, apple juice and brandy, if using, into a large pan. Poke the cloves into the quince pieces and add to the pan along with the ginger and vanilla pod, if using

Stir in the sugar, whole spices and lemon zest. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 40-45 mins until the quince is tender. Pour into mugs or heatproof glasses to serve (strain first, if you like).
